venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Tuesday 10/20 (MOD Jk/MKZ; entered by Mya; posted 9:58pm 10/20).** Net $2,048 vs $2,040 target (+0.4%). Food $248. Comps $69.90. 55 guests, $37.24 check avg. Very quiet bingo day; paused calling numbers for lack of people; new mic setup is much better. Jay with Hennessy came in (every Tuesday so far) and got drinks flowing. Quick push from ~10pm with many returning faces. Kitchen: very calm. 86/low: aquavit. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Tuesday 10/20 (MOD/Chef MD / JMS; entered by BC; posted 12:07am 10/21).** Net $635 vs $1,272 target (-50%). Food $152. Comps $84.15 (13.2%, bingo credits). 23 guests, $27.62 check avg. Sleepy Tuesday; decent little bingo crowd but slower than average, cleared out at 9pm with no further volume increase. Graham from The Optimist sent visiting family over at 10pm; 3 groups of 2 closed the night. Team got ahead on sidework and cleaning projects. 86: Nitrous. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Tuesday 10/20 (AM MOD/Chef Carey; Evening Maggie H; entered by MJH; posted 11:44pm 10/20).** Net $6,975.33 vs $7,919 target (-12%). Event/garden fields reported NA so net = D&C PM total (no events). Food $1,861.25. Comps $183.18. 167 guests (Tock). Tranquil Tuesday; light pop early in AM shift; 5pm biggest pop in the evening, 10pm didn't materialize. Kitchen: light prep tomorrow; 911 GF tempura batter, lime chantilly, cherry vermouth jam; low Wagyu flanks, 8oz burgers. Event: World Energy Day 1 meetings tomorrow, 9 guests, 8am-6pm in suite 6A (use garden door). No incidents.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Tuesday 10/20 (MOD/Chef Kyler/Jane and Steves/Michael; entered by Stef & Jane; posted 10:03pm 10/20).** Net $3,997 vs $4,203 target (-5%). Food $177, beverage $3,820. Comps $179.20 (4.5%; lots of industry and investor love). 120 guests (SevenRooms), form check avg $33. Slower Tuesday that flowed well; full room only around 8:30, rare to have a one-and-done table so guests were walked through cocktail journeys. Top sellers: Rosalie, Shinebox and Native Lion (tie), High Plains Drifter, Luminous Zone. Door: slow start, full ~8-10:45; waitlist peaked ~3 parties; 1 no-show (Jonathan Nassimi). Breakage: 1 tulip, 1 DOF.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Warm, clouds and wind after dark
venues.narrative: **LA — Tuesday 10/20 (MOD/Chef Julian, Josh, Angel; entered by Julian Catano; posted 12:49am 10/21).** Net $4,782 vs $4,823 target (-1%). Food $896 (all Marquee; Standing Room $0). Comps $163.10 (DNLs, gifts, discounts). 106 guests, $45.12 check avg. Slow start (weather); party of 14 early kept the room busy; new host Alex's first solo shift went well. Suntory whiskey rep visited; a cachaca company owner at T19 plans to return. Few members, many new guests. Kitchen: Angel one-man band. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Tuesday 10/20 (MOD Josh; posted 11:32pm 10/20).** Net sales incl. events $4,082.83 (form Total Sales/Marquee $4,357.09; Garden closed). Target reported as '3.5K (not accurate)' so left null. Food $626. Comps $274.26 (several kitchen comps for extended ticket times and food run to wrong tables). 85 guests (form GCA $46.40 / CA $102.26; net/guest $48.03). Slow start 5-7:30pm, picked up ~8:15 with couples and larger parties. Focus: proactive floor, ticket pacing, confirm table numbers before running food. Tuesday oysters led, then franks and potatoes. No-show revenue $30. Maintenance: curtain, paint job. No incidents.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Tuesday 10/20 (Morning Sam & Shannon; Evening Justin & Drew; entered by Justin; posted 8:03pm 10/20).** Net $4,256 vs $3,628 target (+17%). Food $2,313. Muni morning $979, evening $2,948, Sun Club $329, Hot Eye $0. Comps $118.91. Guests 103 (28 AM + 75 PM OpenTable). Very quiet morning with good-sized food tours but little drinking; evening 2-3 tables per server, bar never filled, steady food. Sun Club slow, emptied by 4:40pm. Kitchen: no complaints, no 86s. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Tuesday 10/20 (MOD Curtis Hayes; posted 11:57pm 10/20).** Net $9,188 vs $8,290 target (+11%). Food $1,505. Comps $163.90 (1.8%). 69 reservations, 178 guests, $50.21 avg guest spend. Busier than projected; Frank called out, Taylor covered; Mitchell MVP on wells; oyster shuck-a-thon in the kitchen (Sfian and Wes). Plant vendor swapping the dying bird of paradise for a low-light option. Maintenance: bathroom R fix tomorrow, back bar tap drain and downstairs AC fixed, Ecolab emailed for fly treatment. No incidents.
